rule: Short (2-min) cut. First line 1.5 s; 0.6 s between lines; 0.25 s inside a conversation; +1.0 s before 04_meet and 15_proof; 3 s end hold.

lines.speaker: neha
lines.text: Every month, lenders remind borrowers the same way. Same message. Same time. To everyone.
lines.en: Every month, lenders remind borrowers the same way. Same message. Same time. To everyone.

lines.speaker: neha
lines.text: Most of those messages are ignored. Some annoy people. And every single one costs money.
lines.en: Most of those messages are ignored. Some annoy people. And every single one costs money.

lines.speaker: neha
lines.text: Meet Kairos. An AI that runs loan collections, one person at a time.
lines.en: Meet Kairos. An AI that runs loan collections, one person at a time.

lines.speaker: neha
lines.text: Then it decides. Contact them today, or wait.
lines.en: Then it decides. Contact them today, or wait.

lines.speaker: neha
lines.text: It picks the channel. SMS, WhatsApp, a voice call in their language, or a human. And the best time of day.
lines.en: It picks the channel. SMS, WhatsApp, a voice call in their language, or a human. And the best time of day.

lines.speaker: ritu
lines.text: आपकी EMI पिछले हफ़्ते ड्यू थी। क्या आप शुक्रवार तक पेमेंट कर पाएँगी?
lines.en: Your EMI was due last week. Could you pay by Friday?

lines.speaker: ritu
lines.text: बहुत अच्छा। मैंने शुक्रवार का वादा नोट कर लिया है, और आपको एक रिमाइंडर भेज दूँगी।
lines.en: Great. I've noted your promise for Friday, and I'll send you a reminder.

lines.speaker: neha
lines.text: Before anything is sent, Aladdin, our safety supervisor, checks it against the lender's rules. Twice.
lines.en: Before anything is sent, Aladdin, our safety supervisor, checks it against the lender's rules. Twice.

lines.speaker: neha
lines.text: No messages at night. Never more than allowed. And if someone says stop, everything stops. On every channel.
lines.en: No messages at night. Never more than allowed. And if someone says stop, everything stops. On every channel.

lines.speaker: ritu
lines.text: Understood. You won't get any more messages from us.
lines.en: Understood. You won't get any more messages from us.

lines.speaker: pooja
lines.text: मैंने पेमेंट कर दिया है, ये रहा स्क्रीनशॉट।

lines.speaker: ritu
lines.text: शुक्रिया! बैंक में अभी ये पेमेंट नहीं दिख रहा। मैंने इसे वेरिफिकेशन के लिए टीम को भेज दिया है।
lines.en: Thanks! The bank doesn't show this payment yet. I've sent it to the team to verify.

lines.speaker: neha
lines.text: Every reply, and every payment, teaches Kairos something new. So it gets better, every single day.
lines.en: Every reply, and every payment, teaches Kairos something new. So it gets better, every single day.

lines.speaker: neha
lines.text: And the collections team? They watch the money come in, and approve the few decisions that need a human.
lines.en: And the collections team? They watch the money come in, and approve the few decisions that need a human.

lines.speaker: neha
lines.text: In our tests, Kairos recovered about twice as much money for every rupee spent, compared to a fixed schedule.
lines.en: In our tests, Kairos recovered about twice as much money for every rupee spent, compared to a fixed schedule.

lines.speaker: neha
lines.text: With zero rule breaches. And every safety test passed.
lines.en: With zero rule breaches. And every safety test passed.

lines.speaker: neha
lines.text: Kairos. The right message, at the right time. Or none at all.
lines.en: Kairos. The right message, at the right time. Or none at all.
